What are the implications of your estimate?

Your estimate of the number of red dots in the grid will affect two outcomes:

  1. It will affect the number of Experimental Points that you receive.
  2. It will affect the amount of money that is donated to the charity GiveDirectly.org on your behalf.

This will work in the following way. You will report “Your Estimate”, which will be a number between 0 and 100.

  1. The number of Experimental Points that you receive from this task will be equal to:

$$\text{Your Estimate}$$

  1. The amount that will be donated to the charity GiveDirectly.org on your behalf (in GBP pence, where GBP 1 is equal to 100 pence) be equal to:

$$(100 - \text{Your Estimate})$$

You can read more about the charity GiveDirectly.org if you would like by clicking
Information on GiveDirectly.org

GiveDirectly transfers money to very poor families in developing countries. This charity is rated as one of the nine top charities in terms of cost-effectiveness by the charity evaluation site GiveWell, above many traditional charities in the world. Here is an excerpt from the website GiveDirectly.org presenting its objectives:

“GiveDirectly is a nonprofit that lets donors like you send money directly to the world’s poorest. We believe people living in poverty deserve the dignity to choose for themselves how best to improve their lives — cash enables that choice.”
